parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A caller-minted unique key per logical request (e.g. a UUID). Clients must always send a non-empty key on POST /standards: with the Postgres backing configured, a retry carrying the same key and an identical body replays the original stored response instead of re-executing the create; the same key with a different body is rejected with 422 idempotency-key-reused. Declared required: false because the in-memory configuration accepts the request without a key (no transactional backing to gate on) — never rely on that in a real deployment.
